name: Jolly Phonics
source: Public letter-group teaching order of Jolly Phonics (Lloyd & Wernham, Jolly Learning Ltd)
licence_note: Jolly Phonics is a commercial, trademarked programme (Jolly Learning Ltd). This file encodes only the public order of the 7 letter-sound groups — no proprietary stories, actions, mnemonics, or song content is included.
notes: Group 4's 'ie' and Group 6's second 'th' follow Jolly Phonics' own grouping, which (like Letters & Sounds) teaches oo's two sounds and th's two sounds side by side in one group.

units.label: Group 1 – s, a, t, i, p, n
Group 2 – ck, e, h, r, m, d
Group 3 – g, o, u, l, f, b
Group 4 – ai, j, oa, ie, ee, or
Group 5 – z, w, ng, v, oo, oo
units.notes: oo's two sounds (food/book) are taught together as one group entry.

units.label: Group 6 – y, x, ch, sh, th, th
units.notes: th's two sounds (thin/this) are taught together as one group entry.

units.label: Group 7 – qu, ou, oi, ue, er, ar
units.notes: ue is not in app.js's GRAPHEMES table — see NEEDED_GPCS.md.
